description: Writes a new automation, or a new version of an existing one, from an automation document (ir). Without id it creates one: name, connection_id (the WhatsApp number it belongs to) and ir are then required, and it is created as a draft that does not run. With id it saves a new version of that automation; if it is switched on, the new version goes live with the save, or the save is refused in words and the old version keeps running. It saves only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it saves nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Only the document is accepted: no code, commands, arbitrary URLs or SQL.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) this automation belongs to: its triggers come from it, its messages go from it, and its templates are read on it. Required, and it cannot be moved afterwards. The same recipe (slug) can be set up once on each number, or once per source on it when the recipe has `multiple`.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: upsert_automation
title: Save an automation
